recommendations.name: Greptile Auto-approve PRs
recommendations.description: Approves PRs only after a clean 5/5 review and within a risk cap you set, with path and author filters; works on GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket Cloud and Gitea, but is still in beta.

recommendations.name: cubic auto-approval
recommendations.description: GitHub-only reviewer with a Low-risk-only policy and a shadow mode that reports what it would have approved before you turn on real approvals.

recommendations.name: Cursor PR Routing & Approval agent
recommendations.description: Approves low-risk PRs on GitHub based on risk scoring, Bugbot findings and APPROVAL_POLICY.md files, and also assigns reviewers, but it does not replace a full code review.
